title: Killing of Caltech astronomer Carl Grillmair

tellings.quote: On February 16th, 2026, about 30 mi northeast of Waterman Mountain, where Monica Resza disappeared, another colleague from Caltech and JPL would meet an equally tragic and suspicious end.

plain: On February 16, 2026, a Caltech astronomer named Carl Grillmair was killed in Llano, in California's Antelope Valley, about 30 miles northeast of Waterman Mountain, where his colleague Monica Resza had disappeared. Michels tells it himself, calling it an 'equally tragic and suspicious end' for another colleague from Caltech and NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, in an episode about top scientists who have gone missing, where it would suggest a pattern rather than chance.
